The section name of each MemorySection instance shall be a part of the so-called memory allo- cation keyword used in preprocessor statements in the actual code. ⌋ For example for a memory section entered by the macro RTE_ST ART_SEC_VAR_FAST_8 the MemorySection.symbol shall be VAR_FAST_8. The preprocessor macros contain in addition so-called prefixes which set up a kind of name space and by default are equal to the shortName of the enclosing BswMod- uleDescription or the AtomicSwComponentType (in the above example, the pre- fix is RTE).
